key_corrections.tensor_order_vs_rank: Use 'order' for index count; reserve 'rank' for matrix rank or tensor-decomposition rank.
key_corrections.kappa_tensor_vs_sj_vector: kappa^HS_ij is the order-2 Aitchison pullback metric; s_j = 1/x_j is the order-1 carrier sensitivity vector. Distinct objects.
key_corrections.twin_quaternion_factoring: INV-029's SU(2) x SU(2) factoring is formally 'twin-quaternion factoring', not 'bi-quaternion' (H tensor C). Legacy filename and dimension-policy label retained for repo-history continuity.

session_log.title: Coherent Range Doctrine CRD-1.0
session_log.summary: Coherent Range Doctrine codified at docs/COHERENT_RANGE_DOCTRINE.md (CRD-1.0). For any multi-carrier comparison, valid range = intersection of all members' time ranges; shortest-coverage member sets binding window. Single-carrier reports use native range. Drop-and-recover rule: limiting carrier can be excluded to recover longer range as named appendix. Manifest header (range, T_set, members, start-limiting, end-limiting, drops, policy) on every multi-carrier output.
